name: DeepSeek Harness Desktop Themes
description: Installable desktop appearance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: six signature themes, font presets, live particle/glow effects, durable custom wallpaper, glassmorphism, custom color themes, and a draggable desktop pet (a little-coder character plus ghost/slime/cat) with a quick-switch menu.
author: dsh-desktop-themes contributors
note: This file is human-readable plugin metadata. The authoritative plugin manifest consumed by DeepSeek Harness is the `dsh` field in package.json (see package.json#dsh.client) plus the `cordis.patch.yml` row documented in README.md.
